text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Global Board. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend one candidate for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to be interviewed at its next meeting April 19, 2023 for appointment to the Toronto Global Board: TGB1-33 TGB1-41 TGB1-45 TGB1-27 TGB1-17 2. Directed that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 21, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety, as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Global Board.
